R1.reason: The central charge phase is asserted from inconclusive size trends. Fable assigns a positive-risk window while Opus assigns all-p decoding. Neither assignment establishes the exclusion of the competing behavior; this review does not claim to know the true charge phase.
R1.confidence: provisional numerical review; asymptotic gold answer unavailable

R2.reason: Common record hierarchy, charge equivalences, SU(2) limit and posterior construction pass mathematical review and independent finite-record checks. Gaussian/KT interpretation is not accepted as an exact phase theorem.
R2.confidence: reviewed, not a formal proof-assistant certificate

R3.reason: Supplied path-witness/large-N argument reviewed; key numerical or rational certificate checks pass. N0 is sufficient, not claimed minimal.
R3.confidence: mathematical review plus arithmetic checks; not formal verification

R4.reason: All 210 ordinary held-out posteriors and corrections pass. GPT also passes 18 positive-support endpoint checks; Fable/Opus have range/underflow gaps in their all-positive-record promise.
R4.qualification: Stress probes are post-hoc numerical audits, not prespecified difficulty gates. macOS longdouble is binary64; additional Opus2 ordinary-range portability failures at extremely small p do not reproduce its original Linux extended-precision environment. Its smallest-subnormal p/2 loss is platform-independent.
